turns.assessment: The three telemetry values on oms.S05-S09.amp3 became unusually static, but there is no corroborating optical effect: the downstream S09 channel monitor, the other amplifiers on the section, and relevant receivers saw no change. Every documented amplifier fault would produce either changed pump current, changed output/channel power, degraded downstream OSNR, or signal loss. A frozen-monitoring or telemetry fault is most plausible, but that is not among the documented fault modes, so no listed cause can be committed.
